# Deprecation Requirements Checklist: Documented Command Deprecation Process

**Purpose**: Assess lifecycle, authority, migration, rollback, and offline-validation requirement quality
**Created**: 2026-08-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are record-required cases and explicitly unresolved trigger classes both documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Unresolved Decisions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are every lifecycle stage, transition actor, and approval gate documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all eleven frozen record fields explicitly required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are normal notice and urgent-security exception requirements both documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Are reviewer-checklist and deterministic-command requirements separated from prohibited automation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010–FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the statement that `Proposed` changes no command status unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Are repository-maintainer approval and command-owner execution responsibilities distinguishable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the unresolved `NNNN` allocation and collision policy identified without presenting an inferred rule as decided? [Ambiguity, Spec §Unresolved Decisions]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the undefined proof of a published notice-bearing release identified without assuming a provider? [Ambiguity, Spec §Unresolved Decisions]
- [ ] CHK010 Are explicit absence of a replacement and required rollback treatment stated as reviewable content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are lifecycle names and ordering consistent across requirements, entities, and acceptance scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK012 Are frozen no-automation controls consistent with deterministic local validation requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011–FR-013]
- [ ] CHK013 Are existing-command invariants consistent across scope, non-goals, and measurable outcomes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §SC-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are primary creation and review journeys covered by independently testable acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–3]
- [ ] CHK018 Are urgent removal, unavailable authority, missing rollback, undocumented replacement, and identity conflict covered? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies and Boundaries
